full_prompt_en: A motion-blurred night photograph is viewed along a broad urban road, where several dark cars move toward a bright central vanishing point. Deep blue-black space fills the upper background, filled with blurred high-rise silhouettes and scattered horizontal lights. Near the upper middle, small amber lights recede in staggered pairs, while a few dim white points sit farther back. The roadway begins at the lower edge and narrows toward the centre, its perspective emphasized by long streaks that radiate from the distant light. Several cars occupy the middle and lower portions, their dark bodies remaining recognizable amid the motion blur. White headlights and red tail lamps stretch into short bright lines, with warm orange reflections extending farther across the right side of the pavement. Cooler white and blue streaks spread along the left lane. The nearest vehicle sits just below centre, while other cars form a loose line ahead and beside it. Their blurred edges trail backward along the direction of travel, creating a strong sense of speed without hiding the overall car shapes. The asphalt is nearly black, interrupted by elongated bands of amber, red and pale blue light. A faint road divider and soft horizon remain visible through the blur. The lighting comes from the vehicles and distant urban fixtures; the surrounding buildings read as dim, blurred masses. Small sources bloom softly, and their colors smear across the road surface. The composition draws the eye from the foreground cars toward the narrow bright centre, with converging lines and streaked highlights creating depth. Its mood is energetic and nocturnal, balancing the dark open road with a concentrated stream of moving light.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅带运动模糊的夜间交通摄影画面，视线沿着宽阔城市道路望去，数辆深色汽车朝远处明亮的中央消失点驶行。深蓝近黑的空间铺满上方背景，模糊高楼剪影与零星横向灯光交织其中。画面上方中央附近，几对琥珀色小灯错落后退，更远处还有少量暗淡白点。道路从下缘向中央收窄，远方光点周围放射出的长条模糊强调透视。数辆汽车占据画面中下部，尽管带有运动模糊，深色车身轮廓仍可辨认。白色前灯与红色尾灯拖成明亮短线，暖橙色反光则在路面右侧延伸得更远。左侧车道铺展着偏冷的白蓝色光迹。最近的一辆车位于中央下方，其他车辆在前方和侧边排成松散车流。模糊边缘沿行驶方向向后拖曳，带来强烈速度感，却没有掩去汽车的大致形状。沥青路面近乎黑色，被琥珀、红色和浅蓝色的细长光带打断。模糊中仍隐约看见车道分隔线和柔软地平线。光线来自车辆与远处城市灯具；周围建筑呈现为昏暗模糊的体块。小光源边缘柔亮，颜色在路面上被拉开。构图把视线从前景车辆引向狭窄明亮的中心，汇聚线条和拖曳高光共同形成纵深。整体气氛动感而夜色浓重，在暗色开阔道路与集中的流动光线之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: An optical photographic treatment captures directional motion and glowing exposures. The style uses directional blur to stretch forms and light into lines of motion. Dark fields hold bright white, amber and red accents, while luminous trails converge toward a focal point or sweep laterally across the frame. Edges remain partly readable near the centre and become more diffuse toward the margins, producing depth through changing clarity. Reflections echo the light paths across lower surfaces, and small sources bloom softly against the darkness. Cool and warm streaks can run side by side, keeping the palette vivid but controlled. Composition favors strong directional axes, repeated lines and a clear shift from sharper focal areas to blurred surroundings. The effect is energetic and fast, created through optical movement rather than added detail.
style_prompt_zh: 光学摄影表现捕捉方向性运动和发光曝光效果。这种风格用方向性模糊将形体和光线拉成长条动势。深色区域衬托明亮的白、琥珀和红色点缀，发光轨迹朝焦点汇聚，或横向扫过画面。靠近中心的轮廓仍部分可辨，越到边缘越柔散，通过清晰度变化构成纵深。反射沿下方表面呼应光迹，小光源在暗处柔和泛亮。冷暖光线可以并行出现，使色彩鲜明而有控制。构图偏向明确方向轴、重复线条，以及由较清晰焦点向模糊周边的过渡。整体动感迅疾，来自光学运动效果，而非增加繁杂细节。
theme_en: Several cars travel along a night city road, their lights streaking toward a central vanishing point
theme_zh: 数辆车驶过夜间城市道路，车灯朝中央消失点拉成长线
name: Motion blur
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
